# Fairway Found

> SEO for the AI era. Fairway Found helps public golf courses get found and booked wherever golfers search: AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and classic Google Search and Maps, with bookings landing on the course's own booking page. Based in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas.

## What we do
- Found and booked by AI assistants: answer-ready Q&A content, full structured data, bot-friendly booking deep links, consistent listings and reviews, and monthly AI visibility tracking.
- Local SEO foundation: Google Business Profile optimization, Book-from-Google setup, local landing pages, technical SEO and site speed, review management, and booking-click tracking.

## Reporting
- Five monthly KPIs: AI visibility (mention, citation, and official booking link rates), booking clicks to the course's tee sheet, Google profile actions, local rankings plus organic and AI-referral traffic, and reviews.
- Booking revenue is reported only if the course shares tee sheet data.

## Pricing
- One plan: $1,500 per month. No setup fee. First month free. 12-month agreement with a month-6 walk-away if we haven't moved the numbers.

## Honest note
AI search and booking is an emerging area. No one controls what AI assistants say, and booking support varies by tee sheet provider. We make no guarantees of placement or results.

## Who we serve
Municipal, daily-fee, and semi-private public golf courses.
